newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in Sri Lanka diesel tender from Glencore.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in Sri Lanka diesel tender from Glencore.

text.p: The lowest offer into Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to buy diesel and jet fuel for April 11-12 delivery was made by Swiss trader Glencore, industry sources said on Wednesday.

The 180,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel were offered at 47 cents per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, while the 80,000 barrels of jet fuel was offered at a 40-cent premium, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo.
The tender, which closed on March 18, received seven offers.
The award would be made later on Wednesday, the sources said.
In its last tender, Sri Lanka purchased from Glencore 220,000 barrels of diesel at a 65-cent premium, and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 75-cent premium, c-and-f Colombo.
